info.name: Element Biosciences Cloud Run Service API

params.name: filter
params.description:
Search and filter expression. Space-separated `keyword:value` terms are
 ANDed together; bare text with no keyword searches all string fields. For
 numeric and date fields, replace the colon with a comparison operator
 (`>=`, `<=`, `>`, `<`, `!=`). List alternatives for one keyword with
 commas, e.g. `status:completed,failed`. Dates accept ISO-8601 or relative
 offsets such as `7d` or `1mo`.

 Filterable keywords:

 - **String:** `name`, `id`, `description`, `tags`, `instrument.name`, `instrument.serial_number`, `instrument.model`, `storage.connection_id`, `setup.sequencing.kit_name`, `setup.sequencing.library_structure`, `setup.sequencing.prep_type`, `setup.sequencing.polony_density`, `setup.sequencing.filter_mask`, `setup.sequencing.panel.name`, `setup.multiomics.panel.name`, `setup.multiomics.cartridge.name`
 - **Enum:** `type` (`sequencing`, `multiomics`), `status`, `output.kind` (`sequencing_run`, `multiomics_run`; an alias for `type`), `setup.multiomics.kit_type` (`cytoprofiling`, `direct_in_sample_sequencing`, `antibody_screening`, `tissue`, `protein_screening`), `setup.multiomics.well_layout` (`twelve_well_circle`, `twelve_well_square`, `two_well`, `one_well`, `twelve_well_standard`, `forty_eight_well`)
 - **Date:** `time_created`, `time_started`, `time_completed`, `time_updated`
 - **Numeric:** `metrics.sequencing.total_reads`, `metrics.sequencing.total_yield`, `metrics.sequencing.estimated_reads`, `metrics.sequencing.q30`, `metrics.sequencing.q40`, `metrics.sequencing.q50`, `metrics.sequencing.avg_q`, `metrics.sequencing.error_rate`, `metrics.sequencing.phix_alignment_rate`, `metrics.multiomics.total_cell_count`, `metrics.multiomics.total_cell_confluency`, `metrics.multiomics.total_percent_assigned`, `setup.sequencing.pmg_shift`
 - **Boolean:** `setup.sequencing.low_diversity`

 Examples:

 - `type:sequencing status:completed time_completed>=7d`
 - `instrument.serial_number:AV223501 metrics.sequencing.q30>=90`

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of runs to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

params.name: includeTotalCount
params.description: If true, include total_count in the response (adds a count query)

items.docs: List runs accessible to the authenticated tenant, optionally filtered.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the run

items.docs: Get a single run by its ID.

params.name: prefix
params.description:
Optional path prefix within the run to scope credentials to.
 Run-relative, identical semantics to ListRunFilesRequest.prefix.
 ".." segments are rejected. When omitted, credentials are scoped to
 the whole run (the run root).

params.name: expirationSeconds
params.description:
Lifetime of the returned credentials, in seconds. Optional; defaults to
 1 hour (when 0 or unset). Minimum 900s. Capped by AWS: up to 36h (129600s)
 for federation-token connections, or the role's MaxSessionDuration (12h
 typical) for role-backed connections. Values below the minimum or above the
 cap are rejected.

items.docs:
Get temporary, read-only S3 credentials scoped to a run's storage
 location. Use these for bulk or repeated downloads via the AWS CLI or
 SDK instead of per-object presigned URLs.

params.name: prefix
params.description:
Path prefix within the run, e.g. "visualization/" or "Stats/foo".
 The run is a self-contained namespace: paths do not include any
 bucket-level or workflow-level layout. Round-trips with File.path
 returned by this RPC. ".." segments are rejected.
 Optional: when omitted, lists the whole run (the run root).

params.name: recursive
params.description:
If true, list all files recursively under the prefix (default: true)
 If false, list only files and subdirectories at the current level

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of files to return per page (default: 1000, max: 1000)

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Continuation token from previous response (passthrough from storage)

params.name: includeDownloadUrl
params.description:
If true, populate File.download_url (a presigned URL) on each returned
 file. Defaults to false. Set to true only when the caller intends to
 fetch file content from the response: generating presigned URLs has a
 per-object cost and the URLs themselves are credentials with a
 multi-hour lifetime. Use GetRunDownloadCredentials when long-lived
 bulk access is required.

params.name: downloadUrlExpirationSeconds
params.description:
Lifetime of the presigned download_url, in seconds. Optional; defaults to
 1 hour. Only applies when include_download_url = true. Max 7 days.

params.name: includeDownloadChecksum
params.description:
If true, presign each download_url with S3 ChecksumMode=ENABLED so the
 object's stored checksum is returned on the GET (in the
 x-amz-checksum-<algo> response header) and a client can verify download
 integrity in a single streaming pass. Defaults false; has no effect unless
 include_download_url = true. When enabled the presigned URL signs the
 x-amz-checksum-mode request header, so the fetch MUST send
 x-amz-checksum-mode:ENABLED — a plain GET that omits it fails with HTTP
 403. Best-effort: objects stored without a checksum return none.

 Applies only to AWS S3-backed storage connections; other storage backends
 do not presign S3 GETs and silently ignore this field.

items.docs: List the files produced by a run, drawn from the run's storage location.
